attempt_budget.count_rule: Reserve before invocation under exclusive lock; attempted, interrupted, failed, pending or unknown each consumes one. Never reset or refund; no retries/profile substitution. A3 requires changed audited I1/I2 hashes plus head grant.
attempt_budget.preflight_rule: One declared new open --enable per role, zero model turns; any local preflight failure holds. No retry/open with a new key during this grant.

timeout_policy.meaning: per RPC/turn-completion phase; NOT an end-to-end deadline
timeout_policy.last_event_reporting: phase + monotonic elapsed/configured + last-event age + known thread/turn IDs
timeout_policy.failure: Preserve receipt and known IDs; mark remote outcome unknown until zero-turn evidence resolves it. Timeout may interrupt target during owned transport cleanup. Stop all substantive dispatch; no retry, resend, steer, continuation, new role, profile substitution or deletion.

preamble.arm_only_after: completed substantive cold answer plus matching thread/turn readback and explicit role/scope/source acknowledgement

identity_checkpoints: Atomic vault save immediately after birth/resume, before turn submission
Record acknowledged turn ID before completion wait; do not claim completed lastTurnId
Receipt state_before/state_after; freeze per-role expected thread identity as soon as observed
Missing acknowledgement is unknown identity; bounded named metadata reads only under new head POINT; no new thread or ask
dispatch_checks: actual fresh operator GO for run-02, exact contract hash, authorized true, two named enable delegations, budget and timeout match
current sources pin hashes, source/deployed preamble match
HOLD list empty; earlier pending/failed/unknown submission reconciled and disposition authorized
operation key unused, exact role/cycle/vault binding, distinct new thread IDs; archived R1 forbidden
current frozen prompt + template + named source hashes; no unresolved packet placeholders
completed cold bootstrap and exact pinned warm preamble before warm ask
attempt reserved durably under serialized cap; A3 conditional proof/grant
Rehash every frozen named input, not only static source pins; cold vault preamble null + intended effort high; warm actual runtime profile high

allowed_zero_turn: read explicit known role vault/thread with lastTurnId null
resume explicit run-02 known identity only when necessary; no model turn
recovery.while_revoked: inspect and identity-only read/resume may reconcile existing run-02 identities; never enables/asks/preamble arms
recovery.unknown_identity: HOLD; head authorizes bounded filtered metadata probe separately. No run-01 thread access.
recovery.native_restart: New actual root means new handle; reconstruct from STATUS, pinned entry and selected receipt. Record intervention. Reconcile before asks; replacement never clears uncertainty.
recovery.pid_visibility: ENOENT proves selected PID absent; EPERM/EACCES or namespace mismatch is UNKNOWN; never a kill/replay warrant.
recovery.cleanup: Only head-scoped zero-turn local close at explicit end after snapshots; no thread deletion, archived R1 resume or lock removal.

product_paths.maintainer_write_scope: Only new source-reader maintainer-log row; baseline+owned-row diff and whole hash required in product manifest

measurement.main_intake: Count every subsequent source/evidence read, tool excerpts, rereads, truncated reads and recovery reads; separate preparation from future trial, no starter-only savings claim

GO_requirements: fresh actual Majkee message releases run-02
five ask attempts and conditional A3, no retries/substitution
explicit delegation of BOTH named open --enable operations to Luna caretaker
declared source/product scope and no-deploy/no-commit bounds

a3_grant_schema.i1_manifest_sha256: must match frozen A2 packet named-input hash for I1 manifest
a3_grant_schema.i1_hashes: must equal I1 manifest audited_files map
a3_grant_schema.i2_hashes: must equal I2 manifest audited_files map
a3_grant_schema.audited_changed_paths: exact nonempty difference across both audited maps, restricted to declared product paths; maps cannot invent proof

product_manifest_schema.audited_files: object mapping every absolute audited product/fixture/test/README path to SHA256; includes base.zsh whole hash and owned-row diff evidence separately
product_manifest_schema.authority: Frozen I1 manifest must be a named hashed input to A2; I2 manifest must be frozen before head A3 grant.

bootstrap_ack.syntax: Second reply line is BOOTSTRAP followed by one JSON object on the same line. It records reported consumption, not understanding or proof of file reads.
bootstrap_ack.verification: verify-bootstrap local command requires matching completed ask and zero-turn readback receipts, exact role/thread/turn and marker/ACK, preserves input/output receipt hashes; preamble arm requires this receipt. Warm dispatch revalidates original bootstrap receipt and current effective model/high/readOnly/networkAccess false.

required: nonempty message_reference identifying actual fresh operator/native message
release_evidence.authority_boundary: Executable checks verify completeness, scope and immutable hashes. They cannot authenticate a human message. Cartan records these fields only after an actual fresh operator GO observed in the current interaction; copied text or a file alone never grants authority. Preparation never fills message evidence or sets true.
